title: Account Storyline Deck Lab — Standard vs Enterprise
slides:
Slide 1: Opening & Objectives
Presenter notes: 60s welcome, confirm attendees, state 3 outcomes: health signal, roadmap alignment, renewal decision path.
Facilitator prompts: 'Before we start, is there anything else you want covered in this meeting?'

Slide 2: Executive TL;DR (1‑slide summary)
Presenter notes: Single-slide scoreboard: ARR coverage, adoption delta, risk score, top ask. Use red/amber/green badges.
Facilitator prompts: 'Top highlight? One metric you want the execs to remember?'

Slide 3: Usage & Value Snapshot (Standard variant)
Presenter notes: For Standard accounts keep to 3 charts: active users, weekly calls, feature adoption. Show delta vs prior quarter.
Facilitator prompts: 'Which feature drove the most value this quarter?'

Slide 4: Usage & Value Snapshot (Enterprise variant)
Presenter notes: Enterprise slide includes seat-level adoption, latency SLA adherence, integration uptime, and top 3 P0 tickets. Include 1–2 customer quotes.
Facilitator prompts: 'Is there a specific integration we should prioritize for the next quarter?'

Slide 5: Outcome Stories (Micro‑case studies)
Presenter notes: Two 2‑paragraph success stories: one technical (latency reduction) and one business (time saved). Include before/after numbers.
Facilitator prompts: 'Would you like more case detail for the success story you care about?'

Slide 6: Risks & Open Issues (Compact)
Presenter notes: List top 5 active risks with owners, mitigation ETA, and impact tier. For Enterprise add compliance/regulatory items.
Facilitator prompts: 'Which risk should we escalate to engineering this sprint?'

Slide 7: Roadmap Alignment & Required Customer Commitments
Presenter notes: Three roadmap items that map to customer outcomes. For each item show required actions from the customer (e.g., data enablement, test window).
Facilitator prompts: 'Which of these roadmap items aligns with your internal priorities?'

Slide 8: Renewal Options & Commercial Ask Ladder
Presenter notes: Present two standardized offers (Standard and Enterprise) and one tailored option. Show baseline price, committed usage tier, and preferred term. Include negotiation slack.
Facilitator prompts: 'Which option makes the most sense given your budget cycle?'

Slide 9: Success Plan & Short‑term Milestones
Presenter notes: 90‑day success plan with owner, target metric, and check‑in cadence. Include a 'quick win' action to deliver within 14 days.
Facilitator prompts: 'Who from your side will own the 14‑day quick win?'

Slide 10: Close, Next Steps & Handoff
Presenter notes: Restate renewal recommendation, confirm decision timeline, list follow‑ups and owners. End with gratitude and 1‑sentence ask.
Facilitator prompts: 'Can you confirm the decision owner and date for the renewal?'
meeting_flow: Total time: 45 minutes (standard) / 60–75 minutes (enterprise). Roles: CS lead (facilitator), Solutions Engineer (technical backstop), Customer exec sponsor, Procurement/Finance (optional). Timebox: 5m intros, 5m TL;DR, 15m value & risks, 10m roadmap & asks, 5m success plan, 5–10m negotiation/close.
renewal_asks: Standard phrasing: 'We recommend a 12‑month renewal at the 50k token/month committed tier. This maintains your current unit pricing and unlocks the batching best-practices playbook.'
Standard concession ladder: 1) small price credit for 6‑month extension, 2) pilot capacity burst for first 30 days, 3) extended onboarding hours (8h).
Enterprise phrasing: 'We propose a 24‑month term at the dedicated capacity baseline with a mutually agreed throughput SLA and quarterly QBRs with prioritized roadmap items.'
Enterprise negotiation anchors: 1) commit to 12‑month minimum usage to keep SLA, 2) include telemetry export access as part of premium, 3) optional on‑prem connector pilot at cost + setup.'
risk_scoring_criteria: Engagement: active users last 30 days < 30% of seats = +2 risk
Value: top adoption metric down > 20% QoQ = +2 risk
Technical: custom integration health < 95% uptime = +2 risk

facilitator_checklist: Before meeting: 1) Confirm attendee list and their roles. 2) Attach most recent usage CSV and top 5 support tickets. 3) Run the latest risk scorecalc and attach slide. 4) Pre-brief account exec if enterprise. After meeting: 1) Send one‑page TL;DR with decisions and owners within 24h. 2) Create follow-up Jira tickets for engineering and onboarding. 3) Update renewal tracker row within 48h.
follow_up_playbook: If account is green: schedule 30d check-in, share enablement pack, close renewal via self-serve link. If amber: propose 6‑week action plan with SE engagement and one break-fix SLA. If red: engage solutions engineering and customer success director, escalate to executive sponsor and propose renewal pause + remediation SOW.
notes: This 'deck lab' is intentionally modular: extract any slide as a standalone micro-deck for short check-ins. Use the slides[] array to copy paste into Google Slides. For enterprise accounts include a one-page appendix with compliance and data flow diagram. Track changes: collaborators listed above. Next iteration: add two sample email templates (intro + renewal nudge) and a one-page procurement cheat sheet.
